blocks.text: Yeh chapter 19 (Basics of Organic Chemistry) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 Define organic chemistry according to IUPAC. What is catenation? Explain how catenation and the tetravalency of carbon account for the vast number of organic compounds. (4 marks)
(IUPAC ke mutabiq organic chemistry ki definition likhein. Catenation kya hai? Samjhayein ke catenation aur carbon ki tetravalency bohat se organic compounds ki wajah kaise hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Organic chemistry (IUPAC): un compounds ka mutaala jin mein carbon khud se, hydrogen ya doosre elements se juda ho, siwaye kuch inorganic compounds (carbonates, cyanides jaise KCN, CO₂, CO) ke. 20 million se zyada carbon compounds maloom hain.

Catenation: aik hi element ke atoms ka aapas mein judne ki salahiyat (Latin catena = zanjeer).
• Carbon mazboot C–C covalent bonds se lambi chains aur rings banata hai.
• Carbon tetravalent hai, is liye carbon atoms bohat tareeqon se jur sakte hain (seedhi chain, shaakh wali chain, rings). Maslan chaar carbon atoms ki chaar mukhtalif tarteebein hain.

Nateeja: catenation aur tetravalency mil kar batate hain ke organic compounds pecheeda, bari structures wale aur bohat mukhtalif kyun hain. Organic compounds ke m.p aur b.p kam, densities kam aur paani mein solubility kam hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: Catenation explains why organic compounds are complex

blocks.prompt:
2 What are hydrocarbons? Describe the classification of hydrocarbons on the basis of carbon skeleton, with examples of each class. (4 marks)
(Hydrocarbons kya hain? Carbon skeleton ki bunyad par hydrocarbons ki taqseem misaalon ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Hydrocarbons: sirf carbon aur hydrogen wale compounds.

Carbon skeleton ki bunyad par do qismein:

1. Open chain (acyclic) ya aliphatic hydrocarbons: carbon atoms khuli chain banate hain ('aleiphatos' Greek mein charbi; fats open chain hote hain).
• Saturated: alkanes.
• Unsaturated: alkenes aur alkynes.

2. Closed chain ya cyclic hydrocarbons: carbon atoms rings banate hain.
• Alicyclic: cyclic, saturated ya unsaturated, jo aliphatic jaisa bartao karein, jaise cycloalkanes, cycloalkenes.
• Aromatic: benzene ring ya us jaisi structure wale, jaise benzene, naphthalene, diphenyl methane.

book_ref.quote: On the basis of carbon skeleton, hydrocarbons are broadly classified into two types

blocks.prompt:
3 Define functional group. Explain with examples how functional groups affect the physical properties of organic compounds. Why do alkanes have no functional group? (4 marks)
(Functional group ki definition likhein. Misaalon se samjhayein ke functional groups organic compounds ki physical properties par kaise asar daalte hain. Alkanes mein functional group kyun nahi?)
blocks.explanation:
Functional group: woh atom, atoms ka group ya double/triple bond jo organic compound ki khaas properties tay kare.

Properties par asar: physical aur chemical dono properties functional group par depend karti hain.
• Physical state: methanol aur ethanol liquids, jabke methane aur ethane gases hain.
• m.p aur b.p: alcohols ke m.p aur b.p mutabiq alkanes se zyada hain kyun ke hydroxyl group (–OH) hydrogen bonds banata hai; alkanes nahi bana sakte.
• Solubility: chhote alcohols, carboxylic acids, glucose aur sucrose polar functional groups ki wajah se paani mein hal hote hain.

Compound ki qisam functional group mein (i) bond ki polarity aur (ii) bond order (bonds ki tadaad) se tay hoti hai.

Alkanes aur cycloalkanes mein koi functional group nahi, kyun ke un mein na charge, na polarity, na double ya triple bond hai.

book_ref.quote: Both physical and chemical properties of organic compounds are highly affected

blocks.prompt:
4 Describe the components of a systematic (IUPAC) name of an organic compound. Split 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol into its components. (4 marks)
(Organic compound ke systematic (IUPAC) naam ke hisse bayan karein. 3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol ko us ke hisson mein taqseem karein.)
blocks.explanation:
IUPAC naam parent hydrocarbon par mabni hai aur is ke teen hisse hain:

(i) Stem ya root: sab se lambi musalsal carbon chain jis mein functional group wala carbon ho; us carbon ko sab se chhota number. Ring ho to naam 'cyclo' se shuru.

(ii) Suffix:
• Primary suffix (stem ka suffix): chain saturated hai ya unsaturated (an, en).
• Secondary suffix (key functional group ka suffix): family naam (ol, al, one ...).

(iii) Prefix: side chain (alkyl group) ya substituent (halo, nitro ...) ka naam us carbon ke number ke saath. Prefix na ho to naam = root + suffix.

3-methylbut-2-en-1-ol: prefix 3-methyl; stem but (4 C); primary suffix 2-en (carbon 2 par C=C); secondary suffix 1-ol (carbon 1 par OH).

book_ref.quote: along with number of carbon atom to which it is attached

blocks.prompt:
5 Give the general formula, functional group and IUPAC class name of alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, esters and ethers, with one named example of each. (4 marks)
(Alcohols, aldehydes, ketones, carboxylic acids, esters aur ethers ka general formula, functional group aur IUPAC class naam aik aik naam wali misaal ke saath likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Oxygen wali classes:

book_ref.quote: Each name consists of the components listed below

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the nomenclature of amines (primary, secondary, tertiary), alkyl cyanides and nitroalkanes, giving one correctly named example of each. (4 marks)
(Amines (primary, secondary, tertiary), alkyl cyanides aur nitroalkanes ke naam rakhne ka tareeqa aik aik darust naam wali misaal ke saath bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Amines (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NH₂), teen qismein:
• Primary (–C–NH₂): alkanamine, jaise CH₃–CH₂–NH₂ ethanamine; CH₃–CH(NH₂)–CH₃ propan-2-amine.
• Secondary (–C–NH–R): N-alkylalkanamine; nitrogen par aik H, jaise CH₃–CH₂–CH₂–NH–CH₃ N-methylpropan-1-amine.
• Tertiary (–C–N(R)–R): N par do aik jaise groups hon to N,N-dialkylalkanamine, jaise N,N-dimethylpropan-1-amine; mukhtalif hon to N-alkyl-N-alkylalkanamine, jaise N-ethyl-N-methylpropan-1-amine.

2. Alkyl cyanides (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁N, –C≡N): alkanenitrile (CN ka carbon gina jata hai), jaise CH₃–CN ethanenitrile; CH₃–CH(CH₃)–CN 2-methylpropanenitrile.

3. Nitroalkanes (CₙH₂ₙ₊₁NO₂, –C–NO₂): nitroalkane, jaise CH₃–NO₂ nitromethane; CH₃–CH(NO₂)–CH₃ 2-nitropropane.

book_ref.quote: There are three types of amines

blocks.prompt:
7 Give the functional group, IUPAC class name and two named examples each of alkyl halides, acid amides, acid halides and acid anhydrides. (4 marks)
(Alkyl halides, acid amides, acid halides aur acid anhydrides ka functional group, IUPAC class naam aur do do naam wali misaalein likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Classes aur un ke naam:

book_ref.quote: The IUPAC name is alkanamide

rows: CH₃COCl ethanoyl chloride; CH₃CH₂COCl propanoyl chloride
(CH₃CO)₂O ethanoic anhydride; CH₃CO–O–COCH₂CH₃ ethanoic propanoic anhydride

blocks.prompt:
8 Describe the molecular, empirical and structural formulae of organic compounds. Explain the three types of structural formula, using ethanol as the example. (4 marks)
(Organic compounds ke molecular, empirical aur structural formulae bayan karein. Ethanol ki misaal se structural formula ki teen qismein samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Molecular formula: molecule mein har element ke atoms ki asal tadaad, jaise butane C₄H₁₀, ethanol C₂H₆O. Yeh atoms ki tarteeb ya functional group nahi batata, is liye ethanol aur methoxymethane dono C₂H₆O hain.

2. Empirical formula: atoms ki sab se chhoti poori nisbat, jaise butane C₂H₅, ethanoic acid CH₂O.

3. Structural formula: atoms ki tadaad aur un ke judne ki tarteeb dono. Qismein:
(a) Displayed (graphical): tamam bonds, bonds ki qisam aur functional groups ki jagah. Ethanol mein har C–H, C–C, C–O aur O–H bond banaya jata hai.
(b) Condensed (linear): aik line; single bonds chhor diye, shaakhein aur functional groups bracket mein. Ethanol: CH₃CH₂OH.
(c) Skeletal (bond-line): C aur H ke symbols aur C–H bonds hata diye; C–C bonds zaaviye par milti lines, har carbon ke chaar bond; functional groups dikhaye jaate hain. Ethanol: aik chhoti line jis ke aik sire par OH.

book_ref.quote: There are different types of structural formulae.

blocks.prompt:
9 Deduce the molecular and empirical formulae of the compounds represented by these skeletal formulae: (i) a zig-zag of five single lines with no atom symbols; (ii) a zig-zag of four lines in which the first line is a double line; (iii) two single lines meeting at a joint which carries a double line to O. (4 marks)
(In skeletal formulae se compounds ke molecular aur empirical formulae nikalein: (i) paanch single lines ka zig-zag, koi atom symbol nahi; (ii) chaar lines ka zig-zag jis ki pehli line double hai; (iii) do single lines jo aik jor par milti hain aur us jor se O tak double line hai.)
blocks.explanation: Har jor aur har line ke sire par aik C ginein (jab tak wahan koi aur atom na ho), phir har carbon ke chaar bond poore karne ke liye H jorein; empirical formula ke liye mushtarak factor se taqseem karein.

book_ref.quote: Count the C atoms represented and the heteroatoms shown in the skeleton

steps: (i) Paanch lines 6 nuqte jorti hain, is liye 6 C. Sire ke carbons ko 3-3 H, beech ke 4 carbons ko 2-2 H: H = 2 × 3 + 4 × 2 = 14. Molecular formula C₆H₁₄; 6 : 14 = 3 : 7, empirical formula C₃H₇.

(ii) Chaar lines 5 nuqte jorti hain, is liye 5 C. C-1 (=CH₂) par 2 H, C-2 (=CH–) par 1 H, C-3 aur C-4 par 2-2 H, C-5 par 3 H: H = 2 + 1 + 2 + 2 + 3 = 10. Molecular formula C₅H₁₀; 5 : 10 = 1 : 2, empirical formula CH₂.

(iii) Do lines se 3 C; beech wala carbon O se double bond se juda hai aur us par H nahi; har sire wale carbon par 3 H: H = 6. Molecular formula C₃H₆O (propanone); 3 : 6 : 1 chhota nahi hota, is liye empirical formula C₃H₆O.
blocks.final_answer: (i) C₆H₁₄, empirical C₃H₇; (ii) C₅H₁₀, empirical CH₂; (iii) C₃H₆O, empirical C₃H₆O

blocks.prompt:
10 Using the general formulae of the classes, find the molecular and empirical formulae of (i) an alcohol with 3 carbon atoms (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O), (ii) a carboxylic acid with 4 carbon atoms (CₙH₂ₙO₂), (iii) an alkyl cyanide with 3 carbon atoms (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁N), (iv) an acid amide with 3 carbon atoms (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁ONH₂). (4 marks)
(Classes ke general formulae se (i) 3 carbon wale alcohol (CₙH₂ₙ₊₂O), (ii) 4 carbon wale carboxylic acid (CₙH₂ₙO₂), (iii) 3 carbon wale alkyl cyanide (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁N), (iv) 3 carbon wale acid amide (CₙH₂ₙ₋₁ONH₂) ke molecular aur empirical formulae nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: General formula mein n ki qeemat rakh kar molecular formula nikalein, phir tamam subscripts ko un ke sab se bare mushtarak factor se taqseem kar ke empirical formula.

book_ref.quote: The formula which represents the smallest whole number ratio of atoms of each element

steps: (i) n = 3: H = 2(3) + 2 = 8, is liye C₃H₈O. Nisbat 3 : 8 : 1 ka koi mushtarak factor nahi, empirical formula C₃H₈O.
(ii) n = 4: H = 2(4) = 8, O = 2, is liye C₄H₈O₂. Mushtarak factor 2, empirical formula C₂H₄O.
(iii) n = 3: H = 2(3) – 1 = 5, is liye C₃H₅N. Nisbat 3 : 5 : 1, empirical formula C₃H₅N.
(iv) n = 3: C₃H₅O·NH₂ = C₃H₇NO. Nisbat 3 : 7 : 1 : 1, empirical formula C₃H₇NO.
blocks.final_answer: (i) C₃H₈O / C₃H₈O; (ii) C₄H₈O₂ / C₂H₄O; (iii) C₃H₅N / C₃H₅N; (iv) C₃H₇NO / C₃H₇NO

blocks.prompt:
11 Describe the formation of free radicals, carbocations and carbanions as reactive intermediates when covalent bonds break. Give one example of each. (4 marks)
(Covalent bonds tootne par reactive intermediates ke tor par free radicals, carbocations aur carbanions ke banne ko bayan karein. Har aik ki misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Free radicals (homolysis): nonpolar bond tootne par shared electrons barabar bat-te hain, har atom ke paas aik unpaired electron (nuqta) hota hai.
Cl–Cl → Cl• + Cl•;  H₃C–H → H₃C• + H•
Free radicals reaction intermediates aur bohat reactive hain kyun ke un ke unpaired electrons jora banana chahte hain.

2. Carbocations (polar bond ki heterolysis): aik atom dono electrons rakh kar negative, doosra positive ho jata hai. Jab carbon zyada electronegative atom (O, N, halogens) se juda ho to carbon pair kho deta hai aur carbocation banta hai.
(CH₃)₃C–Cl → (CH₃)₃C⁺ + Cl⁻

3. Carbanions: jab carbon kam electronegative metal (Li, Mg, Cd) se juda ho; carbon pair rakh kar negative ho jata hai, jaise CH₃–Li se CH₃⁻.

book_ref.quote: Carbocation is formed when carbon is bonded to a heteroatom whose electronegativity is more than carbon

blocks.prompt:
12 What are reagent and substrate? Describe the three types of reagents with examples, and explain how polar molecules can be electrophilic or nucleophilic. (4 marks)
(Reagent aur substrate kya hain? Reagents ki teen qismein misaalon ke saath bayan karein aur samjhayein ke polar molecules electrophilic ya nucleophilic kaise ho sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation:
Do reactants ka reaction aik species ka doosri par hamla samjha jata hai: hamla karne wali reagent aur jis par hamla ho woh substrate.

Reagents ki qismein:
(i) Free radicals: unpaired electrons wale atoms ya groups, jaise Cl•, H•, •CH₃, CH₃COO•.
(ii) Electrophiles (electron pasand): naya bond banane ke liye electron pair lete hain; positive ions (carbocations samait) ya neutral molecules, jaise CH₃⁺, H⁺, Br⁺, NO₂⁺, SO₃, BF₃.
(iii) Nucleophiles (nucleus pasand): naya bond banane ke liye electron pair dete hain; negative ions (carbanions samait) ya neutral molecules, jaise CH₃⁻, Br⁻, OH⁻, CN⁻, NH₃, H₂O, ROH.

Polar molecules: yeh istilahat sirf ions ke liye nahi. Bohat se organic molecules par partial charges hote hain:
• CH₃(δ+)–OH(δ–): carbon electrophilic, OH nucleophilic.
• CH₃(δ–)–Li(δ+): carbon nucleophilic, Li electrophilic.

book_ref.quote: A chemical reaction between two reactants may be regarded as the attack of one species on the other

blocks.prompt:
13 Describe substitution, addition and elimination reactions with one equation each. Why is elimination regarded as the reverse of addition? (4 marks)
(Substitution, addition aur elimination reactions aik aik equation ke saath bayan karein. Elimination ko addition ka ulat kyun samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation:
1. Substitution: aik molecule ka atom ya group doosre atom ya group se badal jata hai; do products ban sakte hain.
CH₃–CH₂–Br + KOH(aq) →(H₂O) CH₃–CH₂–OH + KBr  (bromoethane → ethanol)

2. Addition: do reactants aik product dete hain.
CH₂=CH₂ + H₂ →(Ni, 200–300 °C) CH₃–CH₃  (ethene → ethane)
CH₃–CH=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CHBr–CH₃  (bara product 2-bromopropane, Markovnikov's rule)

3. Elimination: substrate ke saath wale do atoms se atoms ya groups nikal kar multiple bond banta hai.
CH₃–CH₂–Br + KOH →(alcohol) CH₂=CH₂ + KBr + H₂O  (bromoethane → ethene)

Addition atoms jor kar multiple bond khatam karta hai; elimination atoms nikaal kar multiple bond banata hai, is liye yeh addition ka ulat hai.

book_ref.quote: Two products may be formed. For example

blocks.prompt:
14 Explain hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation and reduction reactions of organic compounds, giving one equation for each. (4 marks)
(Organic compounds ke hydrolysis, condensation, oxidation aur reduction reactions aik aik equation ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
1. Hydrolysis: compound paani se react kar ke do hisson mein toot-ta hai, aksar H⁺ ya OH⁻ catalyst ki madad se.
CH₃COOCH₂CH₃ + H₂O →(H⁺) CH₃COOH + CH₃CH₂OH

2. Condensation: do molecules mil kar bara molecule banate hain, chhota molecule (H₂O, NH₃, HCl) nikle ya na nikle.
CH₃COCH₃ + H₂N–OH → CH₃C(CH₃)=N–OH + H₂O  (propanone oxime)

3. Oxidation: electrons khona; molecule ke liye oxygen lena, hydrogen khona, C–O bonds ya carbon ki oxidation state barhna.
CH₃–CH=CH₂ →(O₃; Zn/H₂O) CH₃CHO + HCHO  (ethanal + methanal)

4. Reduction: electrons lena, oxygen khona, hydrogen lena, C–O bonds ya carbon ki oxidation state kam hona.
CH₂=CH₂ + H₂ →(Ni) CH₃–CH₃

book_ref.quote: Moreover, if a molecule gains oxygen or loses hydrogen

blocks.prompt:
15 What is a reaction mechanism? Describe the free radical mechanism, taking the chlorination of methane in diffused sunlight as the example. (4 marks)
(Reaction mechanism kya hai? Diffused sunlight mein methane ki chlorination ki misaal se free radical mechanism bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Mechanism: reaction ka woh raasta jo substrate mein bonds ka tootna aur banna dikhaye. Reagents ke lehaz se do bari qismein: free radical aur ionic (polar).

Free radical mechanism: is mein homolysis hoti hai, free radicals bante hain jo substrate molecule par hamla karte hain.
Kul reaction: CH₄ + 4Cl₂ →(diffused sunlight) CCl₄ + 4HCl

Qadam: Initiation → Propagation → Termination
• Initiation: homolysis se shuru ke free radicals bante hain, jaise Cl–Cl → 2Cl•.
• Propagation: yeh radicals mazeed radicals banate hain, reaction zanjeer ki tarah chalta rehta hai yahan tak ke product CCl₄ ban jaye.
• Termination: aik jaise ya mukhtalif free radicals mil jaate hain aur reaction ruk jata hai.

book_ref.quote: This reaction proceeds through the free radical mechanim

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Propagation mein aik radical khatam ho kar naya radical paida karta hai, is liye reaction zanjeer (chain) ki tarah chalta hai; termination mein do radicals mil kar stable molecule bana dete hain aur zanjeer toot jati hai.

blocks.prompt:
16 Describe the ionic (polar) mechanism. Explain nucleophilic substitution, nucleophilic addition, electrophilic addition and elimination, with one example each. (4 marks)
(Ionic (polar) mechanism bayan karein. Nucleophilic substitution, nucleophilic addition, electrophilic addition aur elimination aik aik misaal ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ionic ya polar mechanism mein heterolysis hoti hai, electrophiles aur nucleophiles bante hain jo polar substrate molecules par hamla karte hain. Qismein:

(i) Nucleophilic substitution: nucleophile saturated electrophilic carbon par hamla kar ke doosre nucleophile (leaving group) ki jagah leta hai.
OH⁻ + CH₃–Br → [transition state] → CH₃–OH + Br⁻

(ii) Nucleophilic addition: nucleophile carbonyl compound ke electrophilic carbon par hamla kar ke addition product banata hai.
Cyanide ion ethanal (CH₃CHO) par jur kar 2-hydroxypropanenitrile banata hai.

(iii) Electrophilic addition: electrophile electron se bharpoor (nucleophilic) jagah jaise C=C ya C≡C par hamla karta hai.
CH₂=CH₂ + HBr → CH₃–CH₂Br (bromoethane)

(iv) Elimination: saath wale do carbon atoms se do atoms ya groups nikalte hain aur double ya triple bond banta hai.
OH⁻ + CH₃–CH₂Br → CH₂=CH₂ + H₂O + Br⁻ (Br wala carbon δ+ hai kyun ke Br zyada electronegative hai).

book_ref.quote: The polar mechanism is further divided into the following types

blocks.prompt:
17 Define isomerism. Describe the classification of isomers into structural isomers and stereoisomers, and the further division of stereoisomers. (4 marks)
(Isomerism ki definition likhein. Isomers ki structural isomers aur stereoisomers mein taqseem aur stereoisomers ki mazeed taqseem bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Isomers: do ya zyada compounds jin ka molecular formula aik magar atoms ki tarteeb aur properties mukhtalif hon; yeh phenomenon isomerism hai. Jaise ethanol aur methoxymethane (C₂H₆O).

Isomerism do baaton se paida hoti hai:
1. Structural (constitutional) isomerism: aik hi groups ya atoms molecules mein mukhtalif jagahon par jude hon (Chemistry 11 mein parha).
2. Stereoisomerism: substituents ki fazaai tarteeb, yani configuration, mukhtalif ho.

Stereoisomers ki mazeed qismein:
(a) Optical isomers: physical aur chemical properties aik jaisi siwaye plane polarised light ghumane ke; jaise (+) aur (–) lactic acid.
(b) Cis-trans isomers: open chain compounds mein double bond ke gird restricted rotation ki wajah se mukhtalif fazaai tarteeb; jaise cis- aur trans-but-2-ene.

book_ref.quote: The isomerism of organic compounds stems from the two distinct features

blocks.prompt:
18 What is plane polarised light? Describe how a polarimeter is used to find whether a compound is optically active, and explain the terms dextrorotatory and levorotatory. (4 marks)
(Plane polarised light kya hai? Bayan karein ke polarimeter se kaise pata chalta hai ke compound optically active hai, aur dextrorotatory aur levorotatory ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Plane polarised light (PPL): aik wavelength wali (monochromatic) roshni jo sirf aik plane mein chalti hai.

Polarimeter: PPL ki madad se compound ki optical activity pehchanne aur naapne ka aala (Figure 19.4).
• Compound ka solution PPL ke raaste mein rakha jata hai.
• Agar compound PPL ke plane ko ghuma de to optically active, warna optically inactive.
• Plane of polarisation ghumane ki property ko optical activity kehte hain.

Ghumane ki simt:
• Dextrorotatory (+): PPL ko daayein (clockwise) ghumata hai.
• Levorotatory (–): baayein (anticlockwise) ghumata hai.
Jaise (+) lactic acid aur (–) lactic acid.

book_ref.quote: A solution of the compound under investigation is placed before PPL

blocks.prompt:
19 Explain chirality and the chiral carbon atom. How is optical activity related to the structure of a compound? Use the analogy of hands. (4 marks)
(Chirality aur chiral carbon atom ki wazahat karein. Optical activity compound ki structure se kaise mutaliq hai? Haathon ki misaal istemal karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Bunyadi shart: compound tab hi optically active hai jab woh apni mirror image par superimpose na ho. Aise molecules asymmetric ya chiral hain.

Haathon ki misaal (Figure 19.5): daayan aur baayan haath aik doosre ki mirror image hain magar aik doosre par poore nahi baithte. 'Chiral' Greek 'cheir' (haath) se hai, is liye chirality ko handedness kehte hain.

Achiral: jo molecules apni mirror image par superimpose ho jayein woh achiral aur optically inactive hain.

Chiral carbon: chaar mukhtalif atoms ya groups wala carbon. Jo ghair symmetric molecule PPL ghumaye woh chiral (asymmetric) hai.
• Aik chiral carbon: molecule hamesha asymmetric aur optically active, jaise lactic acid (chiral carbon par CH₃, H, OH, COOH).
• Aik se zyada chiral carbons: molecule asymmetric aur active ho bhi sakta hai aur nahi bhi (jaise meso tartaric acid inactive hai).

book_ref.quote: It can be understood by considering an analogy of our right and left hands

blocks.prompt:
20 What are enantiomers? Explain with lactic acid. What is a racemic mixture and why is it optically inactive? (4 marks)
(Enantiomers kya hain? Lactic acid ki misaal se samjhayein. Racemic mixture kya hai aur yeh optically inactive kyun hai?)
blocks.explanation:
Enantiomers ('enantio' = mukhalif): do stereoisomers jo aik doosre ki non-superimposable mirror images hon.

Lactic acid: is mein aik chiral carbon (* nishan) hai jo chaar mukhtalif groups CH₃, H, OH aur COOH se juda hai. Is ki teen dimensional structure se do non-superimposable mirror images bante hain: (+) lactic acid aur (–) lactic acid.

Properties: enantiomers ki physical aur chemical properties aik jaisi hain magar woh PPL ko barabar miqdaar mein mukhalif simt ghumate hain; aik dextrorotatory (+), doosra levorotatory (–).

Racemic mixture: 50% dextrorotatory aur 50% levorotatory enantiomers ka mixture. Barabar aur mukhalif rotations khatam ho jati hain, is liye yeh optically inactive hai. Naam se pehle (±) likhte hain. Yun lactic acid (+), (–) aur inactive racemic mixture (±) mein milta hai.

book_ref.quote: Its three dimensional structure shows that it has two stereoisomers

blocks.prompt:
21 What are meso isomers? Explain internal compensation with tartaric acid as the example. State the rule for the maximum number of optical isomers and when it does not hold. (4 marks)
(Meso isomers kya hain? Tartaric acid ki misaal se internal compensation samjhayein. Optical isomers ki zyada se zyada tadaad ka qaida aur us ke laagu na hone ki soorat batayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Meso isomers: woh stereoisomers jin mein kam az kam do aik jaise chiral carbon atoms aur plane of symmetry ho; yeh optically inactive hain.

Internal compensation: plane of symmetry molecule ko do barabar hisson mein baant-ta hai, aik hissa doosre ki mirror image. Dono hisse PPL ko mukhalif simt ghumate hain, is liye aik hisse ki rotation doosra usi molecule ke andar khatam kar deta hai. Tartaric acid is ki mashhoor misaal hai (meso tartaric acid).

Qaida: zyada se zyada optical isomers = 2ⁿ, jahan n chiral carbon atoms ki tadaad hai. Maslan n = 1 par 2, n = 2 par 4, n = 3 par 8.

Istisna: agar do ya zyada aik jaise chiral carbons hon to tadaad kam ho jati hai kyun ke meso form ban jata hai, jaise tartaric acid mein.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Racemic mixture mein do alag molecules (enantiomers) aik doosre ki rotation khatam karte hain (external), jabke meso mein aik hi molecule ke do hisse aik doosre ki rotation khatam karte hain (internal compensation).

blocks.prompt:
22 Compare rotation about the C–C single bond in butane with rotation about the C=C double bond in but-2-ene. Explain why rotation about the double bond is restricted. (4 marks)
(Butane mein C–C single bond ke gird rotation ka but-2-ene mein C=C double bond ke gird rotation se muqabla karein. Samjhayein ke double bond ke gird rotation kyun ruki hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Butane: C-2–C-3 single bond ghoomne par methyl groups bhi ghoomte hain aur shakal I, II mein aur wapas I mein badalti hai (free rotation). I aur II conformational isomers hain; aik doosre mein badalne ki wajah se room temperature par alag nahi kiye ja sakte.

But-2-ene, CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃: C-2 aur C-3 sp² hybridized hain.
• C=C mein aik σ bond (sp² orbitals ka seedha overlap) aur aik π bond (p orbitals ka mutawazi overlap) hai.
• π bond molecule ko aik position mein jakar deta hai; C-2, C-3 aur un se jude tamam groups aik plane mein, jagah fixed.
• Free rotation ke liye pehle π bond todna parega, jis ke liye 263 kJ/mol chahiye, jo room temperature par mumkin nahi.

Is liye C=C ke gird rotation ruki hai, aur yahi rukawat cis-trans isomerism ki wajah hai (Figure 19.6): but-2-ene ki do shaklein aik doosre mein nahi badalti.

blocks.prompt:
23 State the necessary and sufficient condition for an open chain compound to show cis-trans isomerism. Which of these show it: CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃, H₂C=CH–CH₂–CH₃, (H₃C)₂C=C(CH₃)₂? How do cis and trans isomers differ in properties? (4 marks)
(Open chain compound ke cis-trans isomerism dikhane ki zaroori aur kaafi shart likhein. In mein se kaun dikhata hai: CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃, H₂C=CH–CH₂–CH₃, (H₃C)₂C=C(CH₃)₂? Cis aur trans isomers properties mein kaise mukhtalif hain?)
blocks.explanation:
Shart: compound mein double bond ho aur har double bond wale carbon se do mukhtalif groups jude hon. Agar aik unsaturated carbon par do aik jaise groups hon to cis-trans isomerism mumkin nahi.

Cis isomer: do aik jaise groups double bond ki aik hi taraf. Trans isomer: mukhalif taraf.

Jaanch:
• CH₃–CH=CH–CH₃ (but-2-ene): har double bond carbon par H aur CH₃, is liye cis-trans isomerism dikhata hai.
• H₂C=CH–CH₂–CH₃ (but-1-ene): C-1 par do H, is liye nahi.
• (H₃C)₂C=C(CH₃)₂ (2,3-dimethylbut-2-ene): har carbon par do CH₃, is liye nahi.

Properties: cis aur trans ki physical aur chemical properties mukhtalif hain. Trans isomer cis se zyada stable hai aur reactivity mukhtalif; m.p, b.p, dipole moment, density aur heat of vapourisation mein farq hai.

blocks.prompt:
24 Explain the importance of stereochemistry in drug development, describing the case of thalidomide. (4 marks)
(Dawaiyan banane mein stereochemistry ki ahmiyat thalidomide ke waqiye ke saath samjhayein.)
blocks.explanation:
Ahmiyat: dawaiyon ki tayyari mein chirality safety aur efficacy ke liye bohat aham hai. Biological systems chiral building blocks se bane hain aur drug receptors khaas 'chiral locks' ki tarah hain, is liye chiral dawa ke do enantiomers ka asar aksar bohat mukhtalif hota hai.

Thalidomide (Figure 19.7):
• Aik tranquilliser jo shuru mein racemic mixture ki shakal mein diya gaya; bazahir kamyab aur ghair zehreela sedative tha.
• 1960s ke shuru mein jin aurton ne hamal ke shuru mein matli (morning sickness) ke liye yeh li, un ke bachche buri tarah maazoor paida hue; dawa fauran wapas le li gayi.
• Research se pata chala ke (+) isomer asar dar aur mehfooz tha, jabke (–) isomer fetus ko nuqsan deta tha.
• Khalis (+) isomer bhi khoon mein jaldi racemise ho jata hai (10 minute mein 50% se zyada), is liye isomers alag karne se khatra khatam nahi hota.
• Baad mein sirf sakht control ke saath dobara market hua (USA: 1998 leprosy ki pechidgi, 2006 multiple myeloma) pregnancy-prevention programme ke saath; chirally stable analogues anti-inflammatory dawaiyon ke tor par parkhe ja rahe hain.
